[[Category:Production]]
'''Total production cost''' is the total financial cost of a [[production]] process.

Depending on convention, tt may include:

* '''Upstream cost'''
** '''Product development cost'''
*** Salary of engineers
*** Prototyping
*** Purchase of patents/designs owned by external actors
*** External certification
** '''Promotion cost'''
*** Advertising
*** Publicity events
* '''Direct costs'''
** Raw material
** Labour
* '''Production overhead'''
** Energy
** Factory rent
** Machine depreciation
** Supervision
* '''Production management cost'''
** Administrative staff
** Buyer/seller
*** Who liaisons with external actors to acquire raw material/sell final product
* '''Downstream cost'''
** Packaging
** Transport/distribution
** Sale
